title: Standardized Preservation, Extraction and Quantification Techniques for Fecal SARS-CoV-2 RNA
author: Aravind Natarajan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-1601/v1
materials: QIAamp Viral RNA Mini Kit (Qiagen; Catalog # 52906)
Extract viral RNA using the QIAamp Viral RNA Mini Kit (Qiagen; Catalog # 52906) according to manufacturer’s instructions.

Amplify the template using the following thermocycling program: 25°C for 2 min, 50°C for 15 min, 95°C for 2 min, 45 cycles of 95°C for 15 sec and 55°C for 30 sec with ramp speed of 1.6°C per second at each step.
Follow manufacturer instructions to partition samples into droplets.

Amplify the template using the following thermocycling program: 50°C for 60 min, 95°C for 10 min, 40 cycles of 94°C for 30 sec and 55°C for 1 min, followed by 1 cycle of 98°C for 10 min and 4°C for 30 min with ramp speed of 1.6°C per second at each step.

steps.title: Prepare BCoV Reagent
steps.instruction: Create an undiluted bovine coronavirus (BCoV) reagent by resuspending one vial of lyophilized Zoetis Calf-Guard Bovine Rotavirus-Coronavirus Vaccine (Catalog # VLN 190/PCN 1931.20) in 3 mL of PBS according to manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Prepare RT-qPCR Standard Curve
steps.instruction: Perform a five-point ten-fold dilution of the SARS-CoV-2 ATCC standard (Catalog # VR-3276SD) ranging from 10^4 to 10^0 copies per µL of template.

steps.title: Process Stool Samples
steps.instruction: Extract supernatant from preserved stool samples using BCoV as an internal control.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the preserved stool sample and vortex well for 5 seconds.
Transfer 600 µL of the sample into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 12 µL of the prepared BCoV vaccine to each 600 µL sample and vortex for 3–5 seconds.
Centrifuge each sample at 10,000x g for 2 minutes to pellet solids (increase speed to 16,000x g if solids do not pellet).
Collect 200 µL of supernatant.
Store samples in a 96-well plate at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare RT-qPCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the RT-qPCR master mix using the following proportions per sample: 5 µL TaqPath 1-Step RT-qPCR CG mastermix (Applied Biosystems, Catalog # A15300), 8.5 µL nuclease-free water (Ambion, Catalog # AM9937), and 1.5 μL of primer/probe mix.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the primer/probe mix (Elim Biopharmaceuticals) contains 200 nM each of forward primer, reverse primer, and probe with 5’ FAM and 3’ TAMRA dyes.
Account for samples, standards, and negative controls in duplicate.
Increase the final volume prepared by 10% to account for dead volume.

steps.title: Run RT-qPCR Assay
steps.instruction: Set up and execute the RT-qPCR reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µL of master mix per well for each sample.
Add 5 µL of eluted sample RNA to each well (total reaction volume 20 µL).
Seal and spin plates down at 500x g for 2 minutes to remove droplets from the side and tops of wells.

steps.title: Analyze RT-qPCR Data
steps.instruction: Quantify RNA concentration and determine detection thresholds.

substeps.instruction: Calculate RNA concentration using a linear regression of the standard curve.
Establish a limit of blank/detection threshold for each plate by picking the highest copy number from among the y-intercept of the line of best fit from the standard curve or negative controls.
Treat samples with copy numbers below this threshold as undetermined/undetected.
Average the copy numbers of replicate wells; if only one of two wells yielded detectable RNA, treat the sample as having no detected viral RNA.

steps.title: Prepare ddPCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the ddPCR master mix using the following proportions per sample: 5.5 µL Supermix, 2.2 µL reverse transcriptase, 1.1 µL of 300 nM Dithiothreitol (DTT), 1.1 µL of 20x Custom ddPCR Assay Primer/Probe Mix (BioRad, Catalog # 10031277), and 6.6 µL of nuclease-free water (Ambion, Catalog # AM9937).

substeps.instruction: Note: Supermix, reverse transcriptase, and DTT are from the One-Step RT-ddPCR Advanced Kit for Probes (BioRad, Catalog # 1864021).

steps.title: Run ddPCR Assay
steps.instruction: Set up and read the ddPCR reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 16.5 µL of master mix per well for each sample.
Add 5.5 µL of eluted sample RNA to each well (total reaction volume 20 µL).
Seal and vortex the plate well for 30 seconds.
Use a droplet reader to read 20 µL of amplified product, ensuring no bumping or rocking of the plate during transfer.

steps.title: Analyze ddPCR Data
steps.instruction: Apply thresholding to quantify ddPCR results.

substeps.instruction: Set the initial threshold between the mean positive and negative amplitudes of the negative and positive controls on each plate.
Calculate the difference between the mean negative amplitude and threshold amplitude in the negative control reactions.
Add this difference to the mean negative amplitude for each sample to apply as the new threshold.
Identify the highest copy number detected in negative controls; treat samples below this threshold as undetermined/undetected.
If too many positive droplets saturate the signal, dilute the sample in water and rerun.
